## Summary

Describe the problem and the user-visible result of this change.

## Validation

List the commands and manual checks performed.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated generated files.
- [ ] `pnpm run check` passes.
- [ ] `pnpm test` and relevant Rust tests pass.
- [ ] User-facing strings are localized in both locale files.
- [ ] Documentation is updated for user-visible or contributor-facing changes.
- [ ] New bundled code, assets, or binaries include the required license and source information.
- [ ] Logs, screenshots, and fixtures contain no credentials, cookies, tokens, or private data.
